record.title: Repeat the unchanged whole-loader candidate with durable runner finalization
record.intent: Test the static three-loader prediction once under the repaired outer collection harness.
requirements: Pin updated harness and unchanged stock observer candidate and verifier; prepare the same tested filesystem and two file labels with four absent paths and preserve source artifacts.
Execute exactly one fresh guest attempt with no adaptive retry and no new modeled MMIO responses; preserve the complete inherited prefix and loader observations or the precise earliest failure.

Retain predicted returns 192 1794240 and minus1, complete payload captures, entry-to-terminal ADC equality, convergence of all traced threads, and stop before SetADCParameter zero; distinguish absent observations from failed predictions.

Run the frozen independent verifier and read-only raw audit; preserve final health command attempts cleanup statuses evidence index and stock hashes even on failure; commit and push the actual conclusion before further guest execution.
acceptance: The one-attempt observation or explicit incomplete outcome is preserved reviewed committed and pushed.
